response.what_it_is: Black standing gas cooker with an electric hotplate and oven
visible_condition: protective plastic wrapping on lower section
hidden_risks: whether all gas burners and the electric hotplate ignite and heat properly
internal condition and heating performance of the oven
integrity of internal gas valves and pipes for leaks
presence of rust or hidden structural damage underneath
response.best_proof: Demonstration video or photo showing all burners lit and the oven operating
response.failure_mode: Overvaluing the appliance based on a clean cosmetic appearance while blindly trusting unverified claims of refurbishment and working condition.
